name: mcp-interactive-editor
description: An MCP App that opens an interactive editor for every file write a model proposes. You edit it by hand, and nothing reaches disk until you say so.
long_description: Claude proposes a file write. A panel opens with the proposed content in an editor and a live diff against what is on disk. You edit it by hand and press the button; nothing reaches the filesystem until you do. Claude cannot approve its own write — the commit tool is not in its tool list.

roots.title: Writable folders
roots.description: Folders the editor may write inside. Anything outside these is refused, symlinks included.

dry_run.title: Dry run
dry_run.description: Run the whole flow but never touch disk. Good for a first pass on a real project.
